units.literal: Now you, sir, have had the fortune to roam in an age of emperors and kings, personally to wear the cap-strings and robes of office, to float amid brilliance and steep yourself in the Way and virtue, to gaze long on the patterns of dragon and tiger—this has gone on long.

units.zh: 卒不能攄首尾，奮翼鱗，振拔洿塗，跨騰風雲，使見之者景駭，聞之者嚮震。
units.en: Yet you never spread wings from the mud or ride the tempest so that sight of you would stagger the world.
units.literal: Yet in the end you cannot spread head and tail, flap scales and fins, struggle free of the mire, leap through wind and cloud, so that those who see you stand awestruck and those who hear you turn in admiration.

units.zh: 徒樂枕經籍書，紆體衡門，上無所蔕，下無所根。
units.en: You hug your books beneath a humble gate, tethered neither to high office nor to solid ground.
units.literal: You merely delight in pillowing your head on the classics and histories, folding your limbs within a plain gate, with nothing above to cling to and nothing below to root you.

units.zh: 獨攄意虖宇宙之外，銳思於豪芒之內，潛神默記，恆以年歲。
units.en: You send the mind past the sky while polishing thoughts on a pinpoint, brooding in silence year on year.
units.literal: Alone you let your thoughts wander beyond the cosmos and hone them finer than a hair's tip; you sink your spirit in silent memorization year after year.

units.zh: 然而器不賈於當己，用不效於一世， 雖馳辯如濤波，摛藻如春華，猶無益於殿最。
units.en: Still your talent finds no buyer today, your use no proof in this life; torrents of eloquence and springtime rhetoric win you no place in the merit roll.
units.literal: Yet your vessel is not priced in the market of the moment, your use is not tested in a single generation; though your disputation surges like breakers and your phrases unfold like spring blossoms, it still does no good in the ranking of first and last.

units.zh: 意者，且運朝夕之策，定合會之計，使存有顯號，亡有美諡，不亦優虖？」
units.en: Why not scheme for office and alliance so the living gain rank and the dead fine posthumous names—would that not be wiser?"
units.literal: Perhaps you should instead ply morning-and-evening stratagems, fix plans for alliance and conference, so that the living win glorious titles and the dead fair posthumous names—would that not be better?"

units.zh: 主人逌爾而咲曰：「若賓之言，斯所謂見勢利之華，闇道德之實，守穾奧之熒燭，未卬天庭而睹白日也。
units.en: The host smiled faintly and said, "What you say is what people call seeing the blossoms of power and profit while remaining blind to the substance of the Way and virtue, guarding a flickering candle in a hidden corner without ever lifting your eyes to the heavenly court to behold the bright sun.
units.literal: The host smiled faintly and said, "If that is your doctrine, it is what people call seeing the flowers of power and profit while blind to the fruit of the Way, guarding a guttering candle in a corner and never lifting your eyes to the celestial court to behold the bright sun.

units.zh: 曩者王塗蕪穢，周失其御，侯伯方軌，戰國橫騖，於是七雄虓闞，分裂諸夏，龍戰而虎爭。
units.en: Once royal roads rotted, Zhou lost control, barons raced abreast, and the seven powers tore China in a war of dragon and tiger.
units.literal: Formerly the royal highways were choked with weeds, Zhou lost the reins, marquises ran on parallel tracks, the Warring States raced crosswise; then the seven champions roared and wrestled, split the central states, and dragon fought with tiger.

units.zh: 游說之徒，風颺電激，並起而救之，其餘猋飛景附，煜霅其間者，蓋不可勝載。
units.en: Rhetoricians stormed in like wind and lightning, and hangers-on swarmed beyond counting.
units.literal: Wandering persuaders, swift as wind and lightning, rose together to rescue the age; the rest, like gales and flying shadows attaching themselves, flashed among them in numbers no carriage could carry.

units.zh: 當此之時，搦朽摩鈍，鈆刀皆能壹斷，是故魯連飛一矢而蹶千金，虞卿以顧眄而捐相印也。
units.en: In that chaos a blunt knife could decide a fate, so Lu Zhonglian felled a fortune with one shaft and Yu Qing dropped a premier's seal at a glance.
units.literal: In such a time, even a rotten twig or a dull blade could cut clean at one stroke; therefore Lu Zhonglian loosed a single arrow and toppled a thousand pounds of gold, and Yu Qing, with a glance, cast away the minister's seal.

units.zh: 夫啾發投曲，感耳之聲，合之律度，淫䵷而不可聽者，非韶、夏之樂也；
units.en: Shrill novelty may please the ear yet fail the scale—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;
units.literal: For twittering runs and tossed-off tunes that please the ear yet, set beside pitch and measure, prove lewd and unfit to hear—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;

units.zh: 因勢合變，偶時之會，風移俗易，乖忤而不可通者，非君子之法也。
units.en: and tactics that chase fashion until custom warps are not the gentleman's law.
units.literal: for opportunism that rides the moment, suits passing fashion, shifts custom, and ends in perverse blockage—that is not the gentleman's law.

units.zh: 及至從人合之，衡人散之，亡命漂說，羇旅騁辭，商鞅挾三術以鑽孝公，李斯奮時務而要始皇，彼皆躡風雲之會，履顛沛之勢，據徼乘邪以求一日之富貴，朝為榮華，夕而焦瘁，福不盈眥，禍益於世，凶人且以自悔，況吉士而是賴虖！
units.en: Think of the vertical and horizontal strategists and the exiles who peddled their arguments: Shang Yang used three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, and Li Si exploited the needs of the age to win over the First Emperor. They caught the winds of opportunity and rode the turmoil of their times, seizing crooked chances to gain a day's wealth and honor. Glorious in the morning, by evening they were ruined; their good fortune did not last a moment, while their calamities burdened the age. Even evil men came to regret this path. How much less should a good man rely on it?
units.literal: When the vertical persuaders united men and the horizontal persuaders divided them, fugitives wandered about arguing and travelers displayed their rhetoric. Shang Yang carried three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, while Li Si exerted himself in the urgent affairs of the age and won over the First Emperor. They all stepped into a conjunction of wind and cloud, trod a situation of upheaval, relied on narrow chances, and rode crooked paths in pursuit of a day's wealth and honor. In the morning they flourished; by evening they were withered. Their good fortune did not last the blink of an eye, while their calamities burdened the age. Even wicked men came to regret this; how much less should a good man rely on it!

units.zh: 且功不可以虛成，名不可以偽立，韓設辯以徼君，呂行詐以賈國。
units.en: Merit cannot be faked nor name bought: Han Fei angled his prince with rhetoric, Lü Buwei sold the realm by deceit.
units.literal: Moreover merit cannot be hollowly achieved, nor name falsely erected: Han Fei set sophistry to hook his ruler, Lü Buwei practiced fraud to traffic in the state.

units.zh: 說難既酋，其身乃囚；
units.en: Han Fei completed "The Difficulty of Persuasion," only to be imprisoned;
units.literal: When the "Difficulty of Persuasion" was finished, his person was imprisoned;

units.zh: 秦貨既貴，厥宗亦隧。
units.en: once Lü Buwei's Qin merchandise had fetched its high price, his clan too sank into the grave.
units.literal: when Qin's bribe had grown costly, his clan too went down the tunnel.

units.zh: 是故仲尼抗浮雲之志，孟軻養浩然之氣，彼豈樂為迂闊哉？
units.en: So Confucius fixed his mind above the clouds and Mencius fed the flood-like breath—were they merely eccentric?
units.literal: Therefore Zhongni set his will above drifting clouds, and Meng Ke nurtured the flood-like qi—did they delight in being impractical?

units.zh: 道不可以貳也。
units.en: The Way allows no divided loyalty.
units.literal: The Way does not admit doubleness.

units.zh: 方今大漢洒埽群穢，夷險芟荒，廓帝紘，恢皇綱，基隆於羲、農，規廣於黃、唐；
units.en: Great Han has cleansed the mire, cut the brambles, stretched the emperor's net wider than Fu Xi or Shen Nong, vaster than Huangdi or Yao;
units.literal: Now the great Han has swept away every stain, leveled peril, mowed the wilds, spread the imperial cord, widened the royal net; its foundation rises higher than Xi and Nong, its compass vaster than Huang and Tang;

units.zh: 其君天下也，炎之如日，威之如神，函之如海，養之如春。
units.en: its rule warms like the sun, awes like a god, holds all like the sea, and quickens like spring.
units.literal: in ruling all under Heaven it blazes like the sun, awes like a spirit, embraces like the sea, nurtures like spring.

units.zh: 是以六合之內，莫不同原共流，沐浴玄德，稟卬太和，枝附葉著，譬猶屮木之殖山林，鳥魚之毓川澤，得氣者蕃滋，失時者苓落，參天墬而施化，豈云人事之厚薄哉？
units.en: Within the six directions all drink one stream, bathe in hidden virtue, and cling like leaves to a tree; timing makes the growth, heaven and earth do the shaping—human whim weighs little.
units.literal: Therefore within the six coordinates none fail to share one source and one current, bathe in dark virtue, drink deep of supreme harmony, cling like branches and leaves; they are like plants growing in mountain forests, birds and fish breeding in rivers and marshes—those who catch the vapor flourish and multiply, those who miss the season wither and fall; Heaven and earth join to spread transformation—how can one speak of human affairs being thick or thin?

units.zh: 今子處皇世而論戰國，耀所聞而疑所覿，欲從旄敦而度高虖泰山，懷氿濫而測深虖重淵，亦未至也。」
units.en: Now you, sir, live in a glorious age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzled by hearsay while doubting what you see. You would use a low mound to gauge Mount Tai and a puddle to fathom the abyss. You are nowhere near the mark."
units.literal: Now you, sir, stand in a brilliant age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzle yourself with hearsay and doubt what your eyes see; you would measure Mount Tai with a yardstick from Dunhuang or fathom the abyss with a puddle from a marsh—you have not reached the mark."

units.zh: 賓曰：「若夫鞅、斯之倫，衰周之凶人，既聞命矣。
units.en: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.
units.literal: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.

units.zh: 敢問上古之士，處身行道，輔世成名，可述於後者，默而已虖？」
units.en: But did the ancients who kept the Way, aided their times, and left great names do it in silence?"
units.literal: May I ask: among men of high antiquity who kept their persons, practiced the Way, aided the age, and won names handed down—did they stay silent?"

units.zh: 主人曰：「何為其然也！
units.en: The host answered, "Why imagine such a thing?
units.literal: The host said, "Why should it be so?

units.zh: 昔咎繇謨虞，箕子訪周，言通帝王，謀合聖神；
units.en: Gao Yao advised Shun, Jizi counseled Zhou—their speech reached kings, their plans matched the spirits;
units.literal: Formerly Gao Yao counseled Shun, Jizi was questioned in Zhou—their words penetrated emperors and kings, their plans matched sages and spirits;

units.zh: 殷說夢發於傅巖，周望兆動於渭濱，齊甯激聲於康衢，漢良受書於邳沂，皆俟命而神交，匪詞言之所信，故能建必然之策，展無窮之勳也。
units.en: Fu Yue was revealed in a dream at Fuyan; Lü Wang's omen stirred on the banks of the Wei; Ning Qi's song rang out at the crossroads; and Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and communed in spirit, relying on more than words; thus they could devise certain strategies and achieve immeasurable merit.
units.literal: The dream of Yin's Fu Yue arose at Fuyan; the omen of Zhou's Lü Wang stirred on the bank of the Wei; Qi's Ning Qi raised his voice at the broad crossroads; and Han's Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and met in spirit, not through trust in spoken words; therefore they could establish certain strategies and unfold inexhaustible merit.

units.zh: 近者陸子優繇，新語以興；
units.en: Lu Jia, calm and unhurried, raised the New Discourses;
units.literal: In recent times Master Lu, leisurely and easy, raised the New Discourses to prominence;

units.zh: 董生下帷，發藻儒林；
units.en: Dong Zhongshu drew his curtain and lit the grove of scholars;
units.literal: Dong Zhongshu let down his curtain and sent brilliance through the Confucian grove;

units.zh: 劉向司籍，辯章舊聞；
units.en: Liu Xiang ordered the archives and clarified antiquity;
units.literal: Liu Xiang superintended the registers and sorted the old hearsay;

units.zh: 揚雄覃思，法言、大玄：皆及時君之門闈，究先聖之壼奧，婆娑虖術藝之場，休息虖篇籍之囿，以全其質而發其文，用納虖聖聽，列炳於後人，斯非其亞與！
units.en: Yang Xiong brooded out the Model Sayings and Great Arcana; each entered the ruler's gate, sounded the sages' chambers, ranged the field of learning, and left texts that shine for posterity—second only to the greatest.
units.literal: Yang Xiong pondered deeply and produced the Model Sayings and the Great Mystery: all reached the inner gates of the timely ruler, fathomed the inner rooms of former sages, wandered in the arena of arts, rested in the park of writings, thereby preserving their substance and releasing their pattern, were taken into the sage's hearing, and blaze in rows for later men—are these not next after the highest?

units.zh: 若乃夷抗行於首陽，惠降志於辱仕，顏耽樂於簞瓢，孔終篇於西狩，聲盈塞於天淵，真吾徒之師表也。
units.en: Then there were Boyi, who upheld his conduct on Mount Shouyang; Liuxia Hui, who humbled his aspirations to take a dishonorable post; Yan Hui, who delighted in his basket of rice and gourd of water; and Confucius, who brought his classic to an end with the hunt in the west. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are truly exemplars for men such as us.
units.literal: Or again, Boyi upheld his conduct on Shouyang; Liuxia Hui lowered his aspirations to accept a humiliating post; Yan Hui delighted in a basket of rice and a gourd of water; and Confucius ended his classic with the western hunt. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are true models for men such as us.

units.zh: 且吾聞之：壹陰壹陽，天墬之方；
units.en: I have heard that yin and yang are the square of heaven and earth;
units.literal: Moreover I have heard: one yin, one yang—this is Heaven and earth's square;

units.zh: 乃文乃質，王道之綱；
units.en: culture and substance are the twin cords of the kingly Way;
units.literal: both pattern and substance—this is the kingly Way's cord;

units.zh: 有同有異，聖喆之常。
units.en: sameness and difference are the sage's constant scales.
units.literal: having sameness and having difference—this is the constant of the wise and good.

units.zh: 故曰：慎修所志，守爾天符，委命共己，味道之腴，神之聽之，名其舍諸！
units.en: The ode says: polish your purpose, keep Heaven's tally, yield life to what is already yours, taste the Way's fat—when spirits listen, can fame stay away?
units.literal: Therefore it is said: carefully cultivate what you aim at, guard your Heaven-given tally, entrust life to what is already in yourself, taste the richness of the Way; when the spirits listen, will fame leave you?

units.zh: 賓又不聞龢氏之璧韞於荊石，隨侯之珠藏於蜯蛤虖？
units.en: Have you never heard how the He-bi jade slept inside a dull rock or Sui's pearl hid in a shell?
units.literal: Again, have you not heard that the He clan jade was wrapped in a Jing stone, or that the Marquis of Sui's pearl lay hidden in a mussel?

units.zh: 歷世莫眡，不知其將含景耀，吐英精，曠千載而流夜光也。
units.en: Ages passed before anyone knew they would blaze with inner fire and gleam in the dark after a thousand years.
units.literal: Age after age none saw them, not knowing they would hold radiant light and spit essence, idle a thousand years yet shed light by night.

units.zh: 應龍潛於潢汙，魚黿媟之，不睹其能奮靈德，合風雲，超忽荒，而躆顥蒼也。
units.en: The winged dragon wallowed in a puddle while minnows mocked him, blind to the day he would ride the storm into the blue.
units.literal: The responding dragon lurked in a muddy pool; fish and turtles despised him, not seeing how he could rouse numinous virtue, join wind and cloud, leap beyond the vast waste, and stand in the azure sky.

units.zh: 故夫泥蟠而天飛者，應龍之神也；
units.en: Mud-bound yet sky-soaring—that is the responding dragon;
units.literal: Therefore one who coils in the mud yet flies to Heaven is the spirit of the responding dragon;

units.zh: 先賤而後貴者，龢、隨之珍也；
units.en: cheap at first, costly later—that is the He jade and Sui pearl;
units.literal: one who is base first and honored later is the treasure of He and Sui;

units.zh: 時闇而久章者，君子之真也。
units.en: long hidden, long bright—that is the gentleman's truth.
units.literal: one who is dim for a time yet shines long is the truth of the gentleman.

units.zh: 若乃牙、曠清耳於管絃，離婁眇目於豪分；
units.en: When Ya and Kuang tune their ears to music, or Li Lou splits a hair's breadth;
units.literal: If then Ya and Kuang clear their ears to strings and pipes, and Li Lou strains his eyes to a hair's fraction;

units.zh: 逢蒙絕技於弧矢，班輸榷巧於斧斤；
units.en: when Peng Meng masters the bow or Lu Ban the adze;
units.literal: Peng Meng exhausts his skill on bow and arrow, Lu Ban measures his craft on axe and adze;

units.zh: 良樂軼能於相馭，烏獲抗力於千鈞；
units.en: when Wang Liang and Bo Le judge horses or Wu Huo hefts a thousand jun;
units.literal: Wang Liang and Bo Le surpass others in judging and driving, Wu Huo matches strength against a thousand jun;

units.zh: 龢、鵲發精於鍼石，研、桑心計於無垠。
units.en: Yi He and Bian Que mastered the needle and stone probe; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang's financial calculations knew no bounds.
units.literal: Yi He and Bian Que brought their finest skill to needles and stone probes; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang applied mental calculation without limit.

units.zh: 僕亦不任廁技於彼列，故密爾自娛於斯文。」
units.en: I am not fit to stack my small talent beside theirs, so I take quiet joy in these words alone."
units.literal: I, your servant, am not fit to crowd my petty skill among them; therefore I quietly take my pleasure in this writing."

units.zh: 伏願陛下哀忠念舊，愛孤恤寡，矜愚嘉善，舍過記功，敦骨肉之情，廣寬仁之路，思堯、舜之風，慕禹、湯之德，克己復禮，以成美化，天下幸甚。」
units.en: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
units.literal: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

units.zh: 世祖徇河北，至下曲陽，彤舉城降，復以為太守，留止數日。
units.en: When Emperor Guangwu advanced through Hebei and reached Xiaquyang, Pi Tong surrendered the city; Guangwu reappointed him governor and kept him there for a few days.
units.literal: When the Shizu campaigned through Hebei and reached Xiaquyang, Tong raised the city in surrender; he was again appointed governor and detained several days.

units.zh: 世祖北至薊，會王郎兵起，使其將徇地，所到縣莫不奉迎，唯和成、信都堅守不下。
units.en: Guangwu then rode north to Ji just as Wang Lang's rebellion erupted. Wang's officers swept the countryside, and county after county opened its gates—only Hegcheng and Xindu refused to submit.
units.literal: When the Shizu went north to Ji, it happened that Wang Lang's troops rose; he sent his generals to seize territory, and in every county they reached none failed to welcome them—only Hegcheng and Xindu held fast and would not yield.

units.zh: 彤聞世祖從薊還，失軍，欲至信都，乃先使五官掾張萬、督郵尹綏，選精騎二千餘匹，緣路迎世祖軍。
units.en: Hearing that Guangwu was retreating from Ji stripped of his main force and heading for Xindu, Pi Tong sent registrar Zhang Wan and touring investigator Yin Sui ahead with over two thousand picked cavalry to escort him along the route.
units.literal: Tong heard the Shizu was returning from Ji having lost his army and intending to reach Xindu; he first sent registrar Zhang Wan and touring investigator Yin Sui to select more than two thousand picked horsemen to meet the Shizu's army along the road.

units.zh: 彤尋與世祖會信都。
units.en: Pi Tong soon joined Emperor Guangwu at Xindu.
units.literal: Tong soon thereafter joined the Shizu at Xindu.

units.zh: 世祖雖得二郡之助，而兵眾未合，議者多言可因信都兵自送，西還長安。
units.en: Even with two loyal commanderies behind him, Guangwu's army was still scattered; many advisers urged him to use Xindu's men as an escort and withdraw west to Chang'an.
units.literal: Although the Shizu had obtained the aid of the two commanderies, his host was not yet united, and those who debated mostly said he could ride Xindu's troops to escort himself west back to Chang'an.

units.zh: 世祖善其言而止。
units.en: Emperor Guangwu judged the argument sound and abandoned the plan to withdraw.
units.literal: The Shizu thought his words good and stopped.

units.zh: 比至堂陽，堂陽已反屬王郎，彤使張萬、尹綏先曉譬吏民，世祖夜至，即開門出迎。
units.en: By the time they reached Tangyang, the town had gone over to Wang Lang. Pi Tong sent Zhang Wan and Yin Sui to reason with the people; Guangwu arrived after dark, and the gates flew open in welcome.
units.literal: By the time they reached Tangyang, Tangyang had already turned back to Wang Lang; Tong sent Zhang Wan and Yin Sui first to explain clearly to officials and people; the Shizu arrived by night, and at once they opened the gates and came out to welcome.

units.zh: 初，張萬，尹綏與彤俱迎世祖，皆拜偏將軍，亦從征伐。
units.en: Zhang Wan and Yin Sui had ridden out with Pi Tong to receive Guangwu; each was named lieutenant general and saw action in the wars.
units.literal: At first Zhang Wan and Yin Sui together with Tong welcomed the Shizu; all were appointed lieutenant generals and also followed in campaigns.

units.zh: 自此常從戰攻。
units.en: After that he fought at Guangwu's side in every major action.
units.literal: From this he constantly followed in battle and attack.

units.zh: 彤親屬所以至今得安於信都者，劉公之恩也。
units.en: My family has stayed safe in Xindu only because of Lord Liu's protection.
units.literal: The reason Tong's kin until now have been able to dwell in peace at Xindu is the grace of Lord Liu.

units.zh: 況明公奮二郡之兵，揚響應之威，以攻則何城不克，以戰則何軍不服！
units.en: How much more may you, my lord, rouse two loyal commanderies and the prestige of a nation that still answers Han—what wall could stand against you, what army refuse you!
units.literal: How much more, when the enlightened lord rouses the troops of two commanderies and raises the might of answering echoes—with such a force what city would not be taken, with such an army what host would not submit!

units.zh: 若明公無復征伐之意，則雖信都之兵猶難會也。
units.en: If you show the world you will not fight on, even the men of Xindu may not rally again.
units.literal: If the enlightened lord has no further mind to campaign, then even Xindu's troops would still be hard to assemble.

units.zh: 明公既西，則邯鄲城民不肯捐父母、背城主，而千里送公，其離散亡逃可必也。
units.en: Once you turn west, the people of Handan will not leave parents and lords to follow you a thousand li; your following would melt away for certain.
units.literal: When the enlightened lord has gone west, then the people of Handan city will not be willing to abandon parents and betray their city lord, and to escort the lord a thousand li; their scattering, fleeing, and running away can be certain.

units.zh: 建武元年，更封靈壽侯，行大司空事。
units.en: In Jianwu 1 he was transferred to marquis of Lingshou and acted as Grand Minister of Works.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianwu he was further enfeoffed as Marquis of Lingshou and acted as Grand Minister of Works.

units.zh: 帝入洛陽，拜彤太常，月餘日轉少府，是年免。
units.en: When the emperor entered Luoyang, Pi Tong was named Minister of Ceremonies; after a little more than a month he was moved to Minister Steward, and that year was dismissed.
units.literal: When the Emperor entered Luoyang, Tong was appointed Minister of Ceremonies; after more than a month he was transferred to Minister Steward, and that same year was dismissed.

units.zh: 即日拜彤為後大將軍，和成太守如故，使將兵居前。
units.en: That same day he named Pi Tong rear grand general while leaving him governor of Hegcheng, and put his command in the lead.
units.literal: That day he appointed Tong rear grand general, his post as governor of Hegcheng remaining as before, and ordered him to lead troops in the van.

units.zh: 六年，就國。
units.en: In the sixth year he went to his fief.
units.literal: In the sixth year he went to his fief.

units.zh: 公方爭國事，彤不得復念私也。』
units.en: You are fighting for the realm; I cannot weigh private ties."
units.literal: The lord is now contending for the state affair; Tong cannot again think of private matters."

units.zh: 若乃議者欲因二郡之眾，建入關之策，委成業，臨不測，而世主未悟，謀夫景同，邳彤之廷對，其為幾乎！
units.en: Consider the advisers who would have marched two loyal commanderies west through the Pass, abandoning a winning position for an unknown—while their lord still hesitated. Pi Tong's speech in council was perilously close to the truth of the moment!
units.literal: As for those debaters who wished to rely on the masses of two commanderies to build a plan of entering the Pass, to cast away completed enterprise and face the unfathomable, while the age's lord had not yet awakened and planners shared one view—Tong's reply in court, was it not close to the mark!

units.zh: 昔三仁去而殷虛，二老歸而周熾，子胥死而吳亡，種、蠡存而粵伯，五□入而秦喜，樂毅出而燕懼，范睢以折□而危穰侯，蔡澤雖噤吟而笑唐舉。
units.en: The Three Worthies left and Shang collapsed; the Two Elders came home and Zhou flourished; Wu died with Wu Zixu; Yue rose while Zhong and Fan Li lived; five captives entered Xianyang to Qin’s delight; Yue Yi’s exile struck terror into Yan; Fan Ju’s stratagem toppled the Marquis of Rang; Cai Ze, stammering all the while, still got the laugh on the physiognomist Tang Ju.
units.literal: Formerly when the Three Worthies left, Yin was hollow; when the Two Elders returned, Zhou blazed; when Zixu died, Wu perished; when Zhong and Li survived, Yue became hegemon; when five [missing] entered, Qin rejoiced; when Yue Yi departed, Yan feared; Fan Ju by breaking [missing] endangered the Marquis of Rang; though Cai Ze stammered and groaned, he laughed at Tang Ju.

units.zh: 蔡澤，山東之匹夫也，顉頤折頞，涕唾流沫，西揖強秦之相，扼其咽，炕其氣，附其背而奪其位，時也。
units.en: Cai Ze was a rough man from the eastern hills—stooped, scarred, slobbering—yet he crossed to Qin, bowed to the chief minister, seized him by the throat, leaned on his back, and took his chair because the hour called for it.
units.literal: Cai Ze was a common fellow from east of the mountains; chin drawn and nose broken, tears and spittle flowing in foam, westward he bowed to the strong Qin minister, choked his throat, checked his breath, clung to his back and seized his position—it was the moment.

units.zh: 范、蔡以下何必《玄》哉？」
units.en: Men like Fan and Cai never needed such a book—why should you?"
units.literal: Below Fan and Cai, why must there be the 'Mystery'?"

units.zh: 有談范、蔡之說於金、張、許、史之間，則狂矣。
units.en: To peddle the stratagems of Fan Ju and Cai Ze in the antechambers of the Jin, Zhang, Xu, and Shi clans would be madness.
units.literal: if there were one who discoursed on Fan and Cai’s doctrines among Jin, Zhang, Xu, and Shi, then he would be mad.

units.zh: 好讀《太玄經》，註揚雄《蜀都賦》。
units.en: He loved to read the Classic of Supreme Mystery and annotated Yang Xiong's Rhapsody on the Capital of Shu.
units.literal: He loved to read the Classic of Supreme Mystery and annotated Yang Xiong's Rhapsody on the Capital of Shu.

units.zh: 每云：「我欲與揚子雲周旋。」
units.en: He would often say, "I wish to keep company with Yang Ziyun."
units.literal: He would often say, "I wish to keep company with Yang Ziyun."

units.zh: 師曠之調鐘，俟知音者之在後也；
units.en: Shi Kuang tuned the bells in hope of a later connoisseur.
units.literal: Shi Kuang’s tuning of bells waits for one who knows sound to come afterward;

units.zh: 沛郡桓譚為司空掾，典其議，為甄豐言：「凡此數者，必有一是。
units.en: Huan Tan of Pei, serving as a Works clerk, oversaw the debate and told Zhen Feng: "Among these proposals, at least one is correct.
units.literal: Huan Tan of Pei commandery, as clerk in Chief Works, handled these discussions and told Zhen Feng: "Among these several proposals, one must be right.

units.zh: 衣食縣官，而為之作，乃兩便，可以上繼禹功，下除民疾。」
units.en: If the state feeds and clothes them while employing them in works, both sides benefit - continuing Yu's legacy above and relieving popular hardship below."
units.literal: If state provides food and clothing and has them work, it is beneficial both ways: above continue Yu's achievement, below remove people's suffering."

units.zh: 己卯，分遣大使宣勞四方，下璽書敕州郡曰：「夫四王革代，商、周所以應天，五勝相推，軒、羲所以當運。
units.en: On jimao day he sent great envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters, issuing sealed letters of instruction to the provinces and commanderies: "The four kings changed the age—Shang and Zhou thus answered Heaven; the Five Agents succeeded one another—Xuanyuan and Fuxi thus met their destined turn.
units.literal: On jimao day he dispatched great envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters and sent down imperial-seal letters instructing the provinces and commanderies, saying: "The four kings changed the age—Shang and Zhou thereby answered Heaven; the Five Victories succeeded one another—Xuan and Xi thereby met their fortune.

units.zh: 㥄素與魏收不協，收既專典國史，㥄恐被惡言，乃悅之曰：「昔有班固，今則魏子。」
units.en: Ling had long been at odds with Wei Shou; once Shou came to monopolize the national history, Ling feared slander and flattered him, saying, "In old times there was Ban Gu; today there is Master Wei."
units.literal: Ling had long been at odds with Wei Shou; once Shou came to monopolize the national history, Ling feared slander and therefore flattered him, saying: "In old times there was Ban Gu; today there is Master Wei."

units.zh: 老子曰：「其政察察，其人缺缺。」
units.en: Laozi said, "When government is excessively exacting, the people grow impoverished in spirit."
units.literal: Laozi said: "When government is minutely scrutinizing, the people are deficient and incomplete."

units.zh: 又曰：「法令滋章，盜賊多有。」
units.en: He also said, "When laws and statutes proliferate, thieves and bandits multiply."
units.literal: He also said: "When laws and decrees multiply, robbers and bandits abound."

units.zh: 成帝初，清河都尉馮逡奏言：「郡承河下流，與兗州東郡分水為界，城郭所居尤卑下，土壤輕脆易傷。
units.en: Early in Emperor Cheng's reign, Qinghe commandant Feng Jun reported: "Our commandery lies in the downstream path and shares watershed boundaries with Yan and Dong. Our settlements are particularly low, with friable soils that are easily damaged.
units.literal: At the start of Emperor Cheng's reign, Qinghe commandant Feng Jun memorialized: "Our commandery receives downstream river flow, sharing water boundaries with Yan and Dong commanderies; our city sites are especially low, and soil is light and fragile, easily damaged.

units.zh: 夫以廟堂、汾水，殊途而同歸，稷、契、巢、許，異名而一貫，出者稱為元首，處者謂之外臣，莫不內外相資，表裏成治，斯蓋萬代同規，百王不易者也。
units.en: Temple and Fen River were different roads to the same end; Ji, Qi, Chao, and Xu were different names for the same principle. Those who served at court were called chiefs; those who withdrew were outer ministers. Inner and outer always supported each other until government was whole. That was the rule for all ages, unchanged by the hundred kings.
units.literal: The temple hall and the Fen River were different paths yet one return; Ji, Qi, Chao, and Xu were different names yet one thread—those who went out were called chief, those who remained were called outer ministers; none failed to support inner and outer, form governance in surface and core; this was the same rule for ten thousand generations and what the hundred kings did not change.

units.zh: 昔陳平背楚，歸漢則強，百里出虞，入秦斯霸。
units.en: Formerly Chen Ping turned from Chu; returning to Han he became strong. Baili left Yu; entering Qin he became hegemon.
units.literal: Formerly Chen Ping turned from Chu; returning to Han he became strong. Baili left Yu; entering Qin he became hegemon.

units.zh: 二月壬子，丞相翟方進薨。
units.en: On Renzi of the second month, Chancellor Zhai Fangjin passed away.
units.literal: Second month Renzi, Chancellor Zhai Fangjin passed away.

units.zh: 咎繇
units.en: Gao Yao
units.literal: Gao Yao

units.zh: 夫能詘於一人之下，而信於萬乘之上者，湯武是也。
units.en: Tang and King Wu could submit to one ruler for a time and ultimately rise above the sovereign of ten thousand chariots.
units.literal: Those able to bend beneath one man and then rise above the ruler of ten thousand chariots were Tang and King Wu.

units.zh: 薨，子放嗣。
units.en: When he died, his son Zhang Fang succeeded him.
units.literal: He died; his son Fang inherited.

units.zh: 臨子 放
units.en: Lin's son: Zhang Fang.
units.literal: Lin's son: Fang.

units.zh: 放為侍中、中郎將，監平樂屯兵，置莫府，儀比將軍。
units.en: Zhang Fang held concurrent rank as palace attendant and general of the household gentlemen, commanded the encamped troops at Pingyue, maintained a full staff, and enjoyed ceremonial honors equal to a field general.
units.literal: Fang was palace attendant and general of the household gentlemen, supervised the Pingyue garrison, set up headquarters, ceremony comparable to a general.

units.zh: 上不得已，左遷放為北地都尉。
units.en: The emperor, unable to refuse outright, relegated Zhang Fang to commandant of Beidi.
units.literal: The ruler had no choice; he demoted Fang to be commandant of Beidi.

units.zh: 後復徵放為侍中光祿大夫，秩中二千石。
units.en: Later he recalled Zhang Fang to serve as palace attendant and grand coachman at the middle rank of two thousand piculs.
units.literal: Afterward again summoned Fang as palace attendant and grand coachman, rank two thousand piculs at middle grade.

units.zh: 太后以放為言，出放為天水屬國都尉。
units.en: At the empress dowager's insistence he was transferred out again, this time as commandant of the Tianshui dependent state.
units.literal: The empress dowager spoke of Fang; he sent Fang out to be commandant of the dependent state of Tianshui.

units.zh: 數月，主有瘳，出放為何東都尉。
units.en: When she had recovered several months later, he posted Zhang Fang as commandant of Hedong.
units.literal: After several months, the princess had recovery; he sent Fang out to be commandant of Hedong.

units.zh: 數月，成帝崩，放思慕哭泣而死。
units.en: A few months later Emperor Cheng died. Zhang Fang grieved so deeply that he wept himself to death.
units.literal: After several months, Emperor Cheng died; Fang thought longing and wept and died.

units.zh: 放子 純
units.en: Zhang Fang's son: Zhang Chun.
units.literal: Fang's son: Chun.

units.zh: 放取皇后弟平恩侯許嘉女，上為放供張，賜甲第，充以乘輿服飾，號為天子取婦，皇后嫁女。
units.en: Zhang Fang married the daughter of Xu Jia, the Marquis of Ping'en and younger brother of the empress. The emperor staged the wedding himself, granted a mansion of the first rank, and filled it with wardrobe and ornaments from the imperial workshops, so that courtiers quipped it was as if the Son of Heaven had taken a bride and the empress had given her daughter away.
units.literal: Fang took the daughter of the empress's younger brother Marquis of Ping'en Xu Jia; the ruler for Fang supplied furnishings, granted a first-ranked mansion, filled it with imperial carriage robes and ornaments, calling it the Son of Heaven taking a wife and the empress marrying a daughter.

units.zh: 鴻嘉中，上欲遵武帝故事，與近臣游宴，放以公主子開敏得幸。
units.en: During the Hongjia era Emperor Cheng wished to revive Emperor Wu's habit of informal outings and banquets with his inner circle. Zhang Fang, as the princess's son—quick-witted and polished—won exceptional favor.
units.literal: In the Hongjia years, the ruler wished to follow Emperor Wu's precedents and with near ministers roam and feast; Fang by being the princess's son open and clever obtained favor.

units.zh: 太后以上春秋富，動作不節，甚以過放。
units.en: She rebuked Zhang Fang harshly, saying the emperor was still young and his conduct at court and abroad lacked restraint.
units.literal: The empress dowager, because the ruler was still in the prime of youth and his conduct lacked restraint, greatly blamed Fang.

units.zh: 時數有災異，議者歸咎放等。
units.en: Omens and disasters multiplied at the time, and memorialists laid the blame at the door of Zhang Fang and his like.
units.literal: At that time repeatedly there were disasters and prodigies; those who deliberated attributed guilt to Fang and others.

units.zh: 於是丞相宣、御史大夫方進奏：「放驕蹇縱恣，奢淫不制。
units.en: Chancellor Xuan and Imperial Counselor Zhu Fangjin therefore submitted a joint memorial: "Zhang Fang is insolent, overbearing, and utterly without self-control—profligate and debauched beyond measure.
units.literal: Thereupon Chancellor Xuan and Imperial Counselor Fangjin memorialized, saying, "Fang is arrogant, remiss, wanton, and unrestrained, extravagant and dissolute without restraint.

units.zh: 前侍御史修等四人奉使至放家逐名捕賊，時放見在，奴從者閉門設兵弩射吏，距使者不肯內。
units.en: When four attendant censors led by Xiu were sent to his house to arrest wanted men by name, Zhang Fang was at home. His slaves barred the gates, strung crossbows, and fired on the officers, defying the imperial messengers and refusing them entry.
units.literal: Formerly attendant censors Xiu and others four men by mission arrived at Fang's house to pursue by name and capture bandits; at the time Fang was present; slave followers closed the gate, set up weapons and crossbows, shot at clerks, and resisted the envoys, refusing to admit them.

units.zh: 奔自髡鉗，衣赭衣，及守令史調等皆徒跣叩頭謝放，放乃止。
units.en: The chief clerk's son Ben shaved his head and donned the convict's iron collar and red robe in token of submission, while the yeoman Diao and the other clerks went barefoot to Zhang Fang's gate to kowtow in apology—only then did he call off his men.
units.literal: Ben shaved himself and collar, wore ochre clothes, and chief clerk assistant Diao and others all went barefoot and knocked heads apologizing to Fang; Fang then stopped.

units.zh: 奴從者支屬並乘權勢為暴虐，至求吏妻不得，殺其夫，或恚一人，妄殺其親屬，輒亡人放弟，不得，幸得勿治。
units.en: His slaves and their hangers-on traded on his power: they murdered a magistrate whose wife they could not take, slaughtered the kin of anyone who offended them, then took refuge inside Zhang Fang's compound. When the authorities could not lay hands on them, they often walked away unpunished.
units.literal: Slave followers' branch kin all rode power and influence to commit violence and cruelty, to the point of seeking an official's wife and not obtaining it, killing her husband, or resenting one man and recklessly killing his relatives; they always fled into Fang's mansion; when not caught, fortunately they were not prosecuted.

units.zh: 放行輕薄，連犯大惡，有感動陰陽之咎，為臣不忠首，罪名雖顯，前蒙恩。
units.en: Zhang Fang's conduct was reckless and he piled up grave crimes, enough to disturb the balance of nature. He stood first among disloyal ministers. His guilt was obvious, yet he had long enjoyed imperial indulgence.
units.literal: Fang's conduct was frivolous; repeatedly he violated great evil; there was a fault of moving yin and yang; as minister unfilial he was chief; though the crime name was manifest, formerly he received grace.

units.zh: 臣請免放歸國，以銷眾邪之萌，厭海內之心。」
units.en: We beg that Zhang Fang be stripped of office and sent to his fief, to nip this evil in the bud and give the empire what it wants to hear."
units.literal: Your servants request to dismiss Fang to his state, in order to dissolve the sprout of many evils and satisfy the mind within the seas."

units.zh: 永始、元延間，比年日蝕，故久不還放，璽書勞問不絕。
units.en: During the Yongshi and Yuanyan reign periods eclipses came year after year, so the emperor kept Zhang Fang away from the capital for a long stretch, though edicts of inquiry and reassurance followed him without cease.
units.literal: Between Yongshi and Yuanyan, year after year solar eclipses; therefore long he did not return Fang; sealed edicts labor inquiries unbroken.

units.zh: 居歲餘，徵放歸第視母公主疾。
units.en: After more than a year abroad he was allowed home to his mansion to nurse his mother, the princess, in her illness.
units.literal: Dwelling more than a year, he summoned Fang to return to his mansion to view his mother the princess's illness.

units.zh: 上雖愛放，然上迫太后，下用大臣，故常涕泣而遣之。
units.en: The emperor still loved Zhang Fang, but he could not withstand pressure from the empress dowager above and his ministers below, and more than once he dismissed him with tears in his eyes.
units.literal: The ruler although loved Fang, yet above was pressed by the empress dowager, below employed great ministers—therefore often wept tears and sent him away.

units.zh: 歲餘，丞相方進復奏放，上不得已，免放，賜錢五百萬，遣就國。
units.en: A year later Chancellor Zhu Fangjin renewed the attack. The emperor had no choice but to dismiss Zhang Fang, grant him five million cash, and order him to his fief.
units.literal: After more than a year, Chancellor Fangjin again memorialized Fang; the ruler had no choice; dismissed Fang, granted cash five million, sent to go to his state.

units.zh: 二月，封侍中衛尉淳于長為定陵侯。
units.en: In the second month, enfeoffed Attendant and Commander of the Guards Chunyu Chang as Marquis of Dingling.
units.literal: Second month, enfeoffed Attendant Commander of the Guards Chunyu Chang as Dingling Marquis.

units.zh: 呂公女即呂后也，生孝惠帝、魯元公主。
units.en: This daughter of Lü Gong would become Empress Lü. She gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.
units.literal: Lü Gong's daughter was namely Empress Lü, gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.

units.zh: 呂后與兩子居田中，有一老父過請飲，呂后因餔之。
units.en: Empress Lü lived in the countryside with their two children. An old man passed by and asked for a drink. Empress Lü fed him.
units.literal: Empress Lü and the two children resided in the fields, there was an old father who passed by requesting drink, Empress Lü because of this fed him.

units.zh: 老父相后曰：「夫人天下貴人也。」
units.en: The old man read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame, you are a noble person of the world."
units.literal: The old father read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame is a noble person of the world."

units.zh: 老父已去，高祖適從旁舍來，呂后具言客有過，相我子母皆大貴。
units.en: The old man had already left. Emperor Gaozu had just returned from a neighboring house. Empress Lü told him everything: a guest had passed by and read the faces of her, the children, and her mother—they were all greatly noble.
units.literal: The old man had already left; Gaozu had just come from the neighboring house. Empress Lü told him in full that a guest had passed by and read the faces of her and her children—all were greatly noble.

units.zh: 高祖隱於芒、碭山澤間，呂后與人俱求，常得之。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang. Empress Lü and others searched for him together and always found him.
units.literal: Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang, Empress Lu and others together sought him, constantly found him.

units.zh: 呂后曰：「季所居上常有雲氣，故從往常得季。」
units.en: Empress Lü said: "There are always clouds above where you stay. That's why we can always find you by following them."
units.literal: Empress Lu said: 'Where Ji resides above constantly has cloud aura, therefore following it constantly finds Ji.'

units.zh: 審食其從太公、呂后間行，反遇楚軍，羽常置軍中以為質。
units.en: Shen Yiji escorted the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü along hidden paths, but they encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu kept them with the army as hostages.
units.literal: Shen Yiji secretly escorted the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü, but encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu constantly kept them in the army as hostages.

units.zh: 呂后兄周呂侯將兵居下邑，漢王往從之。
units.en: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.
units.literal: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.

units.zh: 九月，歸太公、呂后，軍皆稱萬歲。
units.en: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.

units.zh: 卒與高祖。
units.en: In the end, she married Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: In the end he married with the Supreme Ancestor.

units.zh: 九月，漢王遣將軍薛歐、王吸出武關，因王陵兵，從南陽迎太公、呂后於沛。
units.en: In the ninth month, the King of Han sent Generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out through Wuguan to join Wang Ling's troops and proceed from Nanyang to Pei to escort the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü.
units.literal: In the ninth month, King Han sent generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out of Wuguan, relying on Wang Ling's troops, going from Nanyang to welcome the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü from Pei.

units.zh: 臣有息女，願為箕帚妾。」
units.en: I have a young daughter and wish to make her Ji's humble servant."
units.literal: I have a young daughter, wish to make her Ji's broom and dustpan servant."

units.zh: 酒罷，呂媼怒呂公曰：「公始常欲奇此女，與貴人。
units.en: After the wine ended, Lü Po angrily confronted Lü Gong: "You always said this daughter was exceptional and should marry someone noble.
units.literal: The wine ended, Lü Po became angry at Lü Gong and said: "You at first constantly wished to treat this daughter as exceptional, to match her with a noble person.

units.zh: 令相兩子，見孝惠帝，曰：「夫人所以貴者，乃此男也。」
units.en: He had him read the faces of the two children. When he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."
units.literal: She had him read the faces of the two children; when he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."

units.zh: 老父曰：「鄉者夫人兒子皆以君，君相貴不可言。」
units.en: The old man said: "Just now, Madame and the children all take after you. Your appearance shows nobility beyond words."
units.literal: The old father said: 'Just now, madam and the children were all judged noble because of you; your features show nobility beyond words.'

units.zh: 昔劉向有言，王者宜興辟雍、陳禮樂以風天下。
units.en: Liu Xiang once said a king should raise the Bright Academy and display rites and music to sway the realm.
units.literal: Formerly Liu Xiang said that a king should raise the Bright Academy and display rites and music to transform the realm.

units.zh: 臣以為當今四海清平，九服寧宴，經國要重，理應先榮，脫復稽延，則劉向之言徵矣。
units.en: We hold that with the four seas calm and the nine domains at peace, the state's first duty should be honored—delay again, and Liu Xiang's warning will come true.
units.literal: Your subject considers that now within the four seas all is clear and level, the nine domains tranquil and feasting; the essentials of governing the state ought first to be honored—if again delayed, Liu Xiang's words will prove true.
